name: theme-slack-dna
docs: FONTS (required): add to your HTML <head> — CSS @import breaks Vite/lightningcss. <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lato:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">. Then wrap your app root in class="theme-slack-dna" (add sf-enforce if the app bakes font/shadow literals).
title: Slack DNA
description: Slack DNA — aubergine primary, white surfaces, four-color accents, approachable — fonts via <link> (see docs), full app-variable bridge (shadcn + sidebar + charts + font/shadow scales). Wrap your app root in class "theme-slack-dna".
